result.summary: The page is largely functional, but a few horizontally scrolling elements are clipped in ways that can look broken, and some low-contrast placeholder text may be hard to read.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip after “Healthy” is only a thin sliver at the screen edge, which can look like a rendering artifact rather than an intentional scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal scroll affordance, inset padding, or fade/gradient at the edge so off-screen chips look intentionally peeking rather than clipped.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third card is cut off mid-name as “Trattoria Piccol…” with delivery text partially clipped at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Increase trailing padding or use a peek/fade treatment so partially visible cards read as carousel content instead of truncated UI.

issues.description: Search placeholder text “Restaurants, dishes, groceries” is light gray on a very light field and may be difficult for low-vision users to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder/field contrast slightly while keeping placeholder visually secondary to entered text.
